scope: Root-cause the auto-integrator missing-dedicated-integration-path rejection for OPS-DEV-CAPTURE-DEVLOGIN-POSTURE-001 and confirm the original PR #5908 is not stranded.

unblock_request.detail: Cannot integrate OPS-DEV-CAPTURE-DEVLOGIN-POSTURE-001: repository `pantheon` has no explicit integration_path; live execution may not use its worker/source local_path as the merge checkout.

root_cause.summary: During candidate evaluation in scripts/git/auto_integrator.py, live integration execution (--execute) enforces require_dedicated_integration_path=True (line 3433). Candidate discovery sets dedicated_integration_path = bool(resolved_repo.get('integration_path')) (line 607). In the live supervisor runtime configuration at /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json, coordination.repositories.pantheon contained only {'repo': 'ajoe734/pantheon'} and lacked an explicit integration_path entry. Consequently, dedicated_integration_path evaluated to False, triggering the fail-closed rejection at auto_integrator.py:2319-2324 with reason 'missing-dedicated-integration-path' and opening this unblock task.
root_cause.configuration_source: The missing integration_path stems from the runtime replacement recorded in /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/coordination-root/.orchestrator/logs/promotion-20260918T010014Z.json, where promote_supervisor_runtime.py was invoked without providing --repository-integration-root pantheon=<path>, so coordination.repositories.pantheon was rendered without an integration_path. When check_config_drift.py is evaluated with expected integration paths, it flags repository_integration_drift (expected pantheon integration root present under pantheon-ci-deploy/integration-runtimes/pantheon, but live_integration_path=null in live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json).
root_cause.integrator_behavior: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py operated exactly as designed. Per docs/operations/auto-integrator.md § Safety Model, live execution strictly requires a dedicated, isolated checkout for merge operations (coordination.repositories.<id>.integration_path) to prevent destructive merges or race conditions against shared worker or coordination worktrees (such as coordination-root, where ai-status.json is actively mutated). By failing closed with 'missing-dedicated-integration-path', auto_integrator.py prevented unsafe merge attempts against unisolated paths.

The fail-closed requirement for a dedicated integration path protects shared checkouts from unsafe concurrent mutations during automated merges. The missing integration_path was an external deployment/runtime configuration omission during supervisor promotion, not a defect in auto_integrator.py.
